title: Module 2: Rhythm & Chord Change Essentials + Your First Riff — E/A/D chords and the Peter Gunn riff (JustinGuitar)
summary: In this beginner-focused module, JustinGuitar guides new players through the emotional and physical realities of starting guitar while laying a practical foundation: managing fingertip soreness, adopting a forgiving mindset, and setting realistic practice goals. The lesson then pivots to core chords—E, A, and D—and emphasizes how many songs can be played with those three shapes. The instructor previews technique fundamentals (finger placement, thumb behind the neck, strumming mechanics, and rhythm via foot tapping) and introduces a first riff: the Peter Gunn theme (with Blues Brothers as a familiar reference). The video ends by pointing toward expanding repertoire with additional songs and further practice.
